# testing_x_pagination_with_request_array (Data Source)

XPaginationWithRequestArray DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "testing_x_pagination_with_request_array" "my_xpaginationwithrequestarray" {
  id = "...my_id..."
  tags = [
    "..."
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Resource ID

### Optional

- `tags` (List of String) Configurable array that exists ONLY in request, not in response

### Read-Only

- `items` (List of String) Paginated array of items in the response
